name: auth_system
description: Add a complete authentication system to an existing project (register, login, JWT, protected routes).
steps: Detect existing project type (FastAPI / Express / other)
Add User model with id, email, hashed_password, created_at fields
Add JWT token creation and verification
Add /auth/register endpoint: validate email+password, hash password, create user, return token
Add /auth/login endpoint: find user, verify password, return token
Add /auth/me endpoint: decode token, return current user (protected)
Add auth middleware/dependency to protect routes
Update README with auth endpoints documentation
best_practices: Validate email format and minimum password length (8 chars) on register
Never return the hashed password in any response
JWT payload: {sub: user_id, exp: timestamp} — keep it minimal
Access token: 15 minutes. Refresh token: 7 days (store refresh in DB)
Rate limit auth endpoints in production
Use constant-time comparison for password verification (bcrypt handles this)
system_prompt_injection: You are adding authentication to an existing project. First read the existing project structure to understand the codebase. Then implement complete auth: register, login, JWT tokens, and protected route middleware. Write all necessary files and update existing ones. Test that auth endpoints work before finishing.
